audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: "level chart contradicts data: Vayne wins 53.42% but the chart gives Aurora 5/7 stages vs 1". Four rows also contradict their own why-text: row 0 reads Aurora while whys[0] says level 1 is even; rows 3 and 5 read Skill while whys[3] and whys[5] both hand the stage to Aurora; row 6 reads Aurora while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Vayne outscales.
audit.why: 53.42% over 760 games is a scaling win: Aurora owns levels 2 through the first item, Vayne takes it back on two items. The packet chart — Skill / Aurora x5 / Vayne — matches every line of prose already on the page.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and win[0] = Skill (5/10); phases[3].side and win[3] = Aurora (3/10); phases[5].side and win[5] = Aurora (3/10); phases[6].side and win[6] = Vayne (8/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was described as "The Weirding (R)" — The Weirding is Aurora's E. Her ultimate is Between Worlds. phases[4].why also described Final Hour as something that breaks HER engage pattern, on a row the chart gives to Aurora.
audit.why: Between Worlds is 140/120/100s and creates a slowing area she can teleport across; The Weirding is a 15/14/13/12/11s slow-and-hop. Confusing the two makes the level-6 advice unusable, and Final Hour's Tumble invisibility does not carry you out of a slow zone.
audit.corrected: Between Worlds (R) at 6, 140s at rank 1; Twofold Hex 9s at rank 1; Across the Veil 22s at rank 1 is the window that decides walk-ups; Vayne's spikes stay Blade of the Ruined King then two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields (whys[1], spikes[0], mid, wants.foe[0]) claim Aurora's passive procs true damage. Spirit Abjuration does no true damage — it exorcises spirits from damaged enemies that follow her and HEAL her. Two ability names were fabricated: "Across the Sands" for W (real: Across the Veil) and "The Weirding" used as the R. The applicable anti-heal interaction was absent entirely.
audit.why: Inventing true damage on her passive tells the player MR does not help, which is the opposite of the truth — her chip is magic damage and the thing that actually beats you is the healing. That healing is what Grievous Wounds answers, and the page never mentioned it.
audit.corrected: Spirit Abjuration heals her off the poke — buy Executioner's Calling early. Across the Veil (W) is the 22s dash that resets your Silver Bolts stacks; Silver Bolts stacks on attacks AND abilities and the third hit is percent-max-health true damage.
